people.name: Marek
people.description: Marek, a short, round middle-aged man with a neatly trimmed beard, wears a rich velvet cap and a measuring ribbon around his neck as he folds blue linen behind the counter.

knowledge.statement: I run this shop and mend clothing as well as selling it.
The traveler’s clothes cost two gold pieces.
Corin and Jessa are customers here today.

people.wants: Sell suitable clothing at a fair price.

people.name: Corin
people.description: Corin examines a jacket seam, a worn leather pack at his feet.
people.position: beside the clothing rack on the left

knowledge.statement: I used to guide mule trains over the western hills.
I am comparing seams before buying a replacement jacket.
Wool keeps its warmth better than linen when the weather turns cold.

people.wants: Find a durable jacket without wasting coin.

people.name: Jessa
people.role: off-duty soldier buying a warm layer
people.description: Jessa compares warm cloaks, wearing plain clothes and scuffed boots.
people.position: beside the cloak rail on the right

knowledge.statement: I am off duty from the town watch this afternoon.
My uniform is being mended, so I want a warm cloak for my own time.
I prefer a roomy shoulder to an impressive-looking buckle.

people.wants: Buy a comfortable warm layer and enjoy an ordinary afternoon.

things.name: wooden counter
things.detail: The counter is smooth where cloth has been measured. A brass yardstick is fixed along its edge.
things.closer_look: Scratches beside the yardstick mark years of repeated measurements.
things.use_effect: It can be handled and examined.
things.position: across the rear of the shop

things.name: folded paper label
things.detail: A folded paper label rests on the counter. A neat hand has written linen, blue on its face.
things.closer_look: The reverse records the length of the bolt in small, careful numerals.
things.use_effect: It can be handled and examined.

things.name: blue linen bolt
things.short: a bolt of tightly woven blue linen
things.detail: A bolt of blue linen lies beside the yardstick. Its cut edge is clean and the weave is even.
things.picture_description: a bolt of tightly woven blue linen
things.closer_look: The threads have been woven tightly with no obvious gaps.
things.use_effect: It can be handled and examined.

things.name: clothing rack
things.short: a rack of practical wool jackets
things.detail: Several plain wool jackets hang from the rack. Each has wide seams and simple horn buttons.
things.picture_description: a rack of practical wool jackets
things.closer_look: The lower seams leave enough allowance for small alterations.
things.use_effect: It can be handled and examined.

things.name: fitting mirror
things.short: a tall mirror in a wooden frame
things.detail: A narrow mirror stands beside a curtain. Its frame has little dents from years of moving it around.
things.picture_description: a tall mirror in a wooden frame
things.closer_look: The lower corner has a shallow chip in the frame.
things.use_effect: It can be handled and examined.

ways_out.name: street door
ways_out.position: at the front of the shop

offers.name: traveler’s clothes
offers.description: A practical set of traveler’s clothes in sturdy wool and linen.
